2.desc:
Thanks to its no-nonsense design and ease of use, this 120mm Metal Dabber has become an iconic product within the dabbing community.

This dabber is fashioned with a pointy, dagger-like end on one side for shatter and larger diamonds of concentrate, and a rounded, spoon-like end on the other side for sauces and distillates.

At such an affordable price, it's easy to see why this product has gained such widespread popularity in a short time.
